column1: # Suhalla Gate checkpoint: travel papers, Colosso guards, Iodem's arrival and the wounded soldiers.

column3:
Only travelers with
proper papers may pass.
Without them, turn back.{page_break}Show your papers, or
leave this passage
at once.{end_wait}
Are you heading to\nBabi Lighthouse?{end_now}

I never ask why Babi
has ordered me to guard
this passage.{page_break}A soldier follows
orders. I do as I am
told.{end_wait}

I wonder if Colosso
has ended for the year...{page_break}I wish I could have
seen it. Perhaps
next year...{end_wait}
What happened here?\nWho attacked this gate?{end_wait}

Oh...{pause_20_skippable} There's no use.
I don't think I can
stand.{page_break}Please, send help from
Babi Lighthouse when
you reach it.{end_wait}

It's a shame a Colosso
victor should end up
like this...{page_break}When I find them,
I'll make them answer
for what they've done!{end_wait}

Damn it... I can't bear
to let Iodem see me
like this...{page_break}I'd rather crawl into
a hole and hide.{end_wait}

I thought I was dead!
I'm lucky to be alive
at all...{page_break}Those strange men with
wild hair... They were
far too powerful.{end_wait}
Iodem... We tried\nto hold the passage.{end_wait}
Start at the beginning.\nTell me what you saw.{end_wait}

Strangers came without
papers. We ordered
them to turn back.{page_break}They struck before
we could raise
the alarm.{end_wait}
We never had\na chance...{end_wait}
They moved through us\nas if we weren't\neven there.{end_wait}
Fire... and a power\nI couldn't name.\nThen everything went dark.{end_wait}
Could {actor_name:5} have\nbeen among them?{end_now}
Then he may already\nbe near the lighthouse.{end_wait}
We cannot know yet.\nBut someone forced\nthis passage.{end_wait}
And {actor_name:7} is still\nmissing. We cannot\nforget her.{end_wait}
The lighthouse may be\nin danger. We must\nmove quickly.{end_wait}
Not while these men\nlie here wounded.{end_wait}
We can hold on.\nYou have to go...\nbefore it's too late.{end_wait}
But leaving you\nlike this...{end_wait}
We've survived worse\nthan this. Please...\nkeep going.{end_wait}
If the lighthouse\nfalls, Lalivero\nwill pay the price.{end_wait}
Then we cannot\nwaste another moment.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, are you ready?\nWe go together.{end_wait}
